// Source: Go 1.27.3 src/time/time_test.go:1016-1043, plus the two pinned
// Loki inputs and fourteen Pulse controls documented in README.md.
// Reproduction: build with Go 1.27.3, then pass that time_test.go path as
// the executable's first argument. Normal Elixir replay needs no Go.
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"go/ast"
	"go/parser"
	"go/token"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf8"
)

func main() {
	f, err := parser.ParseFile(token.NewFileSet(), os.Args[1], nil, 0)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	inputs := []string{}
	ast.Inspect(f, func(n ast.Node) bool {
		v, ok := n.(*ast.ValueSpec)
		if !ok || len(v.Names) != 1 || v.Names[0].Name != "parseDurationErrorTests" {
			return true
		}
		for _, row := range v.Values[0].(*ast.CompositeLit).Elts {
			input, err := strconv.Unquote(row.(*ast.CompositeLit).Elts[0].(*ast.BasicLit).Value)
			if err != nil {
				panic(err)
			}
			if utf8.ValidString(input) {
				inputs = append(inputs, input)
			}
		}
		return false
	})
	inputs = append(inputs, "not_a_number", "2weeeeee", "1s2", "1\n", "1\t", "1\"", "1\\", "1\x00", "1µx", "1μx", "1😀", "1\x7f", "9223372036854775809unknown", "1.2.3s", "1s-2s", "1s 2s")
	enc := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	enc.SetEscapeHTML(false)
	for _, input := range inputs {
		_, err := time.ParseDuration(input)
		if err == nil {
			panic("expected invalid input")
		}
		if err := enc.Encode([2]string{input, err.Error()}); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
	}
}
